Divine Aegis.note: Proc chain: heal crit → absorb shield on the target. Pairs with Inspiration and Renewed Hope.

Inspiration.note: Proc chain: heal crit → more armor on the target (tank healing).

Vampiric Embrace.note: Resource loop: your Shadow damage becomes party healing while it is on the target.

Spirit Tap.note: Resource loop: kills (or targets dying under Vampiric Embrace) double your Spirit and let mana regen continue while casting.

Dark Inspiration.note: Party buff: Mind Blast and full Mind Flay channels raise Spirit, which Spiritual Guidance turns into power.

Spiritual Guidance.note: Turns Spirit into spell power: Spirit Tap and Dark Inspiration make it stronger.

Improved Mind Flay.note: Rewards full Mind Flay channels; each tick hits harder than the last.

Power in Light.note: Combo: keep Holy Fire or Shadow Word: Pain on the target, then Smite or Penance.

Renewed Hope.note: Combo: heal targets with Weakened Soul (after Power Word: Shield) for more crit, which feeds Divine Aegis.

Holy Binding.note: Flash Heal on others also heals you.

Litany of Light.note: Resource loop: alternate between different heals to get mana back.
